Role Overview
As a Solution Consultant, you’ll work at the intersection of technology and customer adoption. You’ll help ensure customers succeed by bridging business needs with solutions and providing enablement support.

Job Description

Key Responsibilities

● Prototype, validate, and deliver innovative Guidewire Cloud features in real-world customer environments.

● Work directly with customers to capture use cases, requirements and validate solutions.

● Take ownership across the full technology stack, including backend and frontend development.

● Provide feedback loops to Solution Architects and Product Development for continuous improvement.

● Serve as a trusted partner to customers during their transformation journey.

Qualifications

● 2–4 years of experience in technology consulting, solution development, or P&C insurance delivery.

● Hands-on full-stack development experience, including modern software engineering practices such as CI/CD, DevOps, automated testing, and packaging.

● Strong communication and facilitation skills with both business and technical audiences.

● Experience translating requirements into actionable solution designs, and working software.

● Ability to balance consulting finesse with technical competency.

● Works effectively with limited guidance from others, consistently applying established best practices and standards.

● Curious, adaptable, and comfortable working in a fast-paced, innovation-focused environment.
